purpose: Reviewed, portable desktop and app preferences. This audit deliberately excludes application profiles, account data, caches, and history.

included.reason: Dolphin/KDE file dialog UI preferences only.
Small KDE file type preference; no personal data.

included.source: ~/.config/kdeglobals (whitelisted visual, icon, widget, file dialog and window-color sections only)
included.reason: Preserve Noctalia colors and KDE app appearance without exporting unrelated settings.
Preserve common browser, image, video, text and Discord defaults using desktop IDs present on source and represented in package profiles; remove generated userapp IDs and unverified entries.
Portable standard XDG directories through $HOME; no source absolute path.
Waypaper UI defaults with swaybg suitable for niri, bundled Wallpapers folder, and installed matugen command; no stale selection, missing stylesheet or custom keybinding path.
Required user Noctalia KDE color scheme referenced by kdeglobals.

packages: Noctalia color theme available in the deployed data directory
Breeze icon theme as selected by kdeglobals

dependencies.note: Uses desktop IDs verified on source; if a package is omitted on the target, remove its corresponding association or select another installed handler.
Waypaper is optional. Uses the dotfiles payload Wallpapers directory via @DOTFILES_HOME@, expanded by the deploy renderer.

omitted.reason: Contains a large recent-media list with private filenames and home-directory paths; no history exported.
Application-wide VLC settings were not needed for a reliable install; excludes the whole VLC profile rather than risk exporting private paths or transient state.
State names a specific Hyprpaper wallpaper and Hyprland script; waytrogen is not in package lists and niri uses Noctalia wallpaper handling.
Profile and scene data can capture hardware, sources, device IDs, and private stream endpoints; no OBS state was exported.

omitted.reason: Contains account profiles, credentials, session tokens, databases, device identifiers, histories, or machine-specific state; excluded wholesale.
Recent locations, metadata, caches, databases and histories are not portable preferences.

review_notes: No passwords, access tokens, account profiles, recent-media lists, session data, private capture endpoints, or database files were copied.
No install script or application was run.
